title: Tripadvisor Review
description: A user review for a Tripadvisor location including rating, text, trip type, and reviewer information.

id.description: The unique identifier for this review.

lang.description: The language code of the review.

location_id.description: The Tripadvisor location ID this review is for.

published_date.description: The date and time the review was published in ISO 8601 format.

rating.description: The overall rating given by the reviewer.

helpful_votes.description: The number of helpful votes this review has received.

rating_image_url.description: URL of the rating bubble image for this review's rating.

url.description: URL of the full review on Tripadvisor.

text.description: The full text content of the review.

title.description: The title or headline of the review.

trip_type.description: The type of trip associated with this review.

travel_date.description: The date of travel associated with this review in YYYY-MM format.

subratings.description: Sub-rating scores for specific aspects of the location (e.g., service, value, cleanliness).

UserReference.description: Reference to a Tripadvisor user who authored the review.

name.description: The display name of the reviewer's location.

id.description: The location ID of the reviewer's location.

thumbnail.description: URL of the reviewer's thumbnail avatar.

small.description: URL of the reviewer's small avatar.

large.description: URL of the reviewer's large avatar.

SubRating.description: A sub-rating score for a specific aspect of a location.

name.description: The name of the sub-rating category (e.g., Service, Value).

rating_image_url.description: URL of the rating bubble image for this sub-rating.
